Messages.Body:
hi !

i was thinking of the applications of the renewed thaumaturgy strikes.

i'm still curious about the wording from superior "Skin of the adder"
" This vampire [prevent one damage eacj round ] and his hand strikes
inflicts an additional damage."

why is the wording different from, say, fist of death or strength of the
bear ? why not +1 strength ?
maybe to avoid interaction with melee weapon like Garrote or wooden stake ?

anyway here are the scenarios :

- Kemintry plays sup skin of the adder then sup blood rage (now a hand
strike). How much damage does she inflict ?
2 (i guess not) or 3 (should be logical) ?

-Samantha plays blood rage : does she inflict 1 aggravated damage
unpreventable by fortitude ?

(is it a kewlkombo Tm paired with amaranth and gangrel conspiracy ?)

-blythe in combat with Ozzy plays superior blood rage : i guess she inflicts
only one damage ?

thank you !

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
reyda wrote:
>
> hi !
>
> i was thinking of the applications of the renewed thaumaturgy strikes.
>
> i'm still curious about the wording from superior "Skin of the adder"
> " This vampire [prevent one damage eacj round ] and his hand strikes
> inflicts an additional damage."
>
> why is the wording different from, say, fist of death or strength of the
> bear ? why not +1 strength ?
> maybe to avoid interaction with melee weapon like Garrote or wooden stake ?

Yes.

It is designed to mimic the fangs that can be grown with that power in
the RPG. So only hand strikes (read: bites) receive the bonus.

You'll still get the occasional odd interaction (with, say, Wolf Claws),
but this being a card game, you have to accept some of that.

> anyway here are the scenarios :
>
> - Kemintry plays sup skin of the adder then sup blood rage (now a hand
> strike). How much damage does she inflict ?
> 2 (i guess not) or 3 (should be logical) ?

It is a hand strike. So SotA means it inflicts an additional damage.

> -Samantha plays blood rage : does she inflict 1 aggravated damage
> unpreventable by fortitude ?

Yes.

> (is it a kewlkombo Tm paired with amaranth and gangrel conspiracy ?)

jaice.

> -blythe in combat with Ozzy plays superior blood rage : i guess she inflicts
> only one damage ?

Yes.
